_comment: ORDER-1350. DATED swap-mode + swap-charge probe on the pinned lane. Written by lane S-2026-08-04-SWAPPROBE. This file exists because the premise in scripts/swap_adjust_crypto.py is a 2026-07-26 measurement of BROKER STATE, and broker state moves under it -- so a probe result is only meaningful with the date it was taken. Two probes, both diagnostic: (TST)_SymbolSwapProbe reads the spec and places no orders; (TST)_SwapChargeProbe holds one position and reports what the tester actually charged. No verdict is issued here and no cell is judged.

note: swap_long was -14.67 pct/yr when the same probe was run 2026-07-26. The RATE MOVED between the two dates while the MODE did not. That is a second, independent confirmation of ORDER-1330's mechanism: the symbol specification is an input to every backtest and no record carries it.

refutes: the 2026-07-26 conclusion recorded in scripts/swap_adjust_crypto.py's docstring, that a SYMBOL_SWAP_MODE_INTEREST_CURRENT symbol is NOT charged swap by the tester -- net == price-only P&L to the cent. On this dated run the tester charged -20.21 on a single 0.01-lot position held 70 days, so it is not zero and the two figures are not equal.
note: -20.21 is the same order of magnitude as, and somewhat below, a naive annual-rate calculation over the same hold (0.01 lot x contract 1 x ~103k mean notional x 14.31 pct / 360 x 70 = about 29). The gap is rollover-day counting and the price the tester values each daily charge at; it is NOT the difference between charged and not charged. No adjusted profit factor is recomputed from this record -- that is ORDER-1370's job and it is applied to every arm at once.
